static_analysis.next_production_build: SUCCESS (21 App Router routes compiled cleanly with Turbopack and Partial Prerendering)

findings.title: Overdue Sweep Idempotency & Concurrent Submission Overlap
findings.description: Risk that repeated or overlapping autonomous sweeps with candidate manual submissions could attempt double-evaluation or produce duplicate scoring records.
findings.resolution: Implemented and verified atomic state CAS and idempotent evaluation retrieval. Validated via DB-EXAM-16 (repeated sweeps), DB-EXAM-17 (concurrent manual submit & sweep), and DB-EXAM-18 (delayed sweep recovery). All resolve to strictly 1 evaluation record v1.

findings.title: Candidate API View Privacy & Answer Key Redaction
findings.description: Candidate delivery endpoints must never leak isCorrect flags, answer keys, or explanations in API payloads prior to official result disclosure.
findings.resolution: Enforced strict DTO projections in getExamAttempt and startExamAttempt, completely omitting isCorrect, correctOptionLabels, and answerKey. Verified via DB-EXAM-19.

findings.title: Candidate Lifecycle Browser Selector & Component Synchronization
findings.description: Playwright test runner encountered ambiguous selectors where palette filter tabs matched question grid buttons and exact text matching was required for modal counters.
findings.resolution: Refined Playwright selectors to target aside .grid button with regex boundaries and exact text matches for modal completion stats. 14/14 browser specifications pass 100% green.

findings.title: Open-Redirect Vector Immunity & Next Path Strict Sanitization
findings.description: Authentication signin and callback endpoints required validation against protocol-relative (//evil.com) and backslash (/\evil.com) open-redirect vectors.
findings.resolution: Enforced sanitizeNextPath across signin page, OAuth action, and callback route. Added unit test suite in auth-validation.test.mjs covering malicious URL variations.

limitations.description: All 194 automated tests, database triggers, migrations, and builds ran against local disposable PostgreSQL 16 container (127.0.0.1:5433). Actual deployment to hosted Supabase Staging and Vercel hosting requires explicit human approval as defined in STAGING_RUNBOOK.md.
OAuth callbacks (GitHub/Google) were verified via mock Supabase Auth server on 127.0.0.1:54321. Production OAuth keys must be added to Supabase dashboard before public end-user staging sign-in.
